description: Bonescythe Gauntlets Level 60 Rohan the Assassin at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Bonescythe Gauntlets if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Gauntlets, 8 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 5 Cured Rugged Hides. Requirements: - Desecrated Gauntlets - Wartorn Leather Scrap x 8 - Arcanite Bar - Cured Rugged Hide x 5
name: Bonescythe Gauntlets
